name: Identity display-transform snapshot guard

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
# Hypothesis

`EditableTextState::update_layout` materializes `snapshot.text()` before calling the display
transform, even when the default identity transform necessarily returns no projection. Bypassing
that materialization on the identity branch removes a whole-buffer allocation from the ordinary
TextArea layout path while preserving transformed display text behavior.

## Scope lock

This experiment changes only identity-transform projection selection. It does not alter
incremental row splicing, cache behavior, prepaint, or transformed projection mapping.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
# Measurement plan

Run the page-isolated headed WASM/WebGPU TextArea wheel fixture at DPR 1 and 2 with five warmups
and thirty measured samples each, inspect the DPR 2 screenshot, and retain raw artifacts. Source
inspection must prove `snapshot.text()` is called only for non-identity display transforms.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
# Expected outcome

The default identity TextArea remains visually and interactively identical, including scroll,
selection, and caret geometry. Non-identity projection behavior remains unchanged because it still
receives the authoritative snapshot text.

measurements.target: headed WASM WebGPU TextArea wheel action
measurements.protocol: One page-isolated 35-run Playwright process per DPR with five warmups and thirty measured samples.

reportMarkdown:
# Identity display-transform snapshot guard

All 70 headed WASM/WebGPU samples passed and the DPR 2 screenshot retained the expected scrolled
TextArea. The identity-only guard is rejected because the full fixed benchmark is mixed.

| DPR | Prior p50/p95 | Candidate p50/p95 | Change p50/p95 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 129.493 / 141.935 ms | 133.356 / 143.637 ms | +3.0% / +1.2% |
| 2 | 137.290 / 143.619 ms | 133.718 / 143.870 ms | -2.6% / +0.2% |

The source is restored to the checkpoint and raw artifacts are retained.
decisionMarkdown:
# Decision

Reject the identity display-transform guard: its direct allocation reduction does not yield a
reliable two-DPR timing improvement under the fixed workload.
